results.question: Who are the best auto repair shops in Tupelo, MS?

chatgpt.text:
Here’s who I’d call first in **Tupelo**:

- **Tom’s Automotive Service — 317 Magazine St.** Best all-around pick. They’re **AAA Approved**, do full-service mechanical/body work, and list **ASE Master Certified** technicians—good signs if you want one dependable shop. ([aaa.com](https://www.aaa.com/autorepair/locations/tupelo-ms?utm_source=openai))

- **Johnson Service Center — 508 Daybrite Dr.** My “local-trust” pick. CARFAX shows **5.0 stars from verified customers**, and local Reddit recommendations specifically mention them for serious engine/mechanical work. ([carfax.com](https://www.carfax.com/Reviews-Johnson-Service-Center-Tupelo-MS_FKNOEEKQAI?utm_source=openai))

- **Auto Medic Imports — 3552 Jeff Homan Blvd.** Best if you drive an import or European car. CARFAX shows **4.8 stars**, and locals point people there for European vehicles. ([carfax.com](https://www.carfax.com/Reviews-Auto-Medic-Imports-Tupelo-MS_NLQ3ZVJ001?utm_source=openai))

- **Express Oil Change & Tire Engineers — W Main or N Gloster.** Good for oil changes, tires, brakes, and quicker routine maintenance; both Tupelo locations show strong customer-review volume. ([loc8nearme.com](https://www.loc8nearme.com/mississippi/tupelo/auto-repair/?utm_source=openai))

I’d get a written estimate, ask about parts/labor warranty, and avoid authorizing “while we’re in there” work without a second call.

If you’re a homeowner in Tupelo, you know how important it is to have a reliable mechanic you can trust with the family cars. Based on local reputation, consistent quality work, and fair dealing, here are the shops I’d recommend:

*   **Tupelo Automobile Repair:** If you want honest diagnostics and old-school customer service, this is a go-to spot. Locals rave about their integrity—they won’t upsell you on repairs you don’t need, and their turnaround times are very dependable.
*   **Gateway Tire & Service Center:** For routine maintenance, tires, brakes, and suspension work, Gateway is hard to beat. As homeowners, we appreciate convenience, and they are quick, efficient, and stand behind their warranties without giving you the runaround.
*   **Express Oil Change & Tire Engineers:** For quick oil changes, state inspections, and minor services where you don't want to leave your car all day, these guys are top-notch. You can stay in your car, and their staff is consistently polite and professional.

Stick with one of these three depending on the job, and you’ll be in good hands.
